name: sprintengine-calendar
description: Calendar workspace extension for SprintEngine Studio, built against @sprintengine/module-sdk.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.sign: sprintengine-module sign module --key "${SPRINTENGINE_SIGNING_KEY:-$HOME/.sprintengine/keys/calendar-signing.key}" && sprintengine-module plugin sign . --key "${SPRINTENGINE_SIGNING_KEY:-$HOME/.sprintengine/keys/calendar-signing.key}"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate
